response.rationale: Both answers correctly express the intended sense. Indonesian lantai is standard for a building floor, while Malaysian Malay tingkat is a common ordinary term; aras is also a valid Malaysian alternative. The different-common-word relation is useful but not exclusive. No false-friend contrast is needed.
